purpose: Estimate a bounded mip LOD from explicit screen-space texture-coordinate derivatives. This kernel does not sample a texture.

types.dx: float2 partial derivative of uv with respect to screen x
types.dy: float2 partial derivative of uv with respect to screen y

kernel_signature: estimate_lod(float2 dx, float2 dy, uint2 image_dimensions, uint mip_level_count) -> float
preconditions: image width and height are positive
postconditions: output lies between zero and the final available mip level
no image read, write, or mip sampling occurs

notes: dx and dy are screen-space coordinate derivatives used for footprint estimation; they are not learned weights.
A discrete mip-level choice is not differentiable at level boundaries.
Training a sampler requires a separate backward contract for dL/dUV and dL/dTexture; LOD gradients require an explicit trilinear, stop-gradient, or custom-gradient policy.
LearningLane and track:GRADIENT remain separate; any future gradient proposal must pass their verification and authorized commit gates.
